summary: Preserved candidate PR 2861's valid DFlash2 dynamic-verification implementation, independently reproduced review PR 2947's finite JSON to float32 infinity STS counterexample at exact candidate commit cdd6ac7f5940e15c97cafbee61c0baf3ce4a9603, and rejected calibration temperatures that are non-finite after conversion to the runtime float32 dtype.

tests.what_was_measured: At cdd6ac7f5940e15c97cafbee61c0baf3ce4a9603, STS temperatures [1e308, 2.0] became tensor([inf, 2.]) and calibrated confidence became [0.5, 0.7311]; the finite-runtime assertion failed.
The new regression verifies oversized finite JSON calibration values are rejected after float32 conversion and the existing head calibration remains unchanged.
75 tests passed for DFlash confidence/configuration, logits compatibility, shared scheduler behavior, and STS parsing/application.
One ROCm GPU test and 22 parameterized subtests passed against independent PyTorch references for the shared scheduling and verification kernels.
Modified Python compiled and the patch was whitespace-clean.

gpu_execution.evidence: HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 ran the shared DSpark/DFlash scheduling kernel parity suite; 1 GPU test and 22 independent numerical-reference subtests passed. See gpu-kernel-parity.log.

remaining_limitations: No compatible DFlash2 checkpoint with a trained survival head was supplied or cached, so enable_confidence_head naming, real tensor shapes, bias, dtype, optional Markov schema, and checkpoint loading remain unverified against an actual artifact.

No compatible DFlash2 target/draft pair was supplied or cached, so lossless end-to-end semantics across sampling, grammar, continuous batching, overlap relay, and live compact graph replay remain unverified.
Mixed-quality concurrent-workload throughput remains unmeasured in live DFlash2 serving.
The qualified tiny Llama fixture was not used because it validates transport and engine execution only and cannot qualify DFlash2 architecture, semantics, or throughput.
No native C/C++/CUDA/HIP/FlyDSL source changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
